

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Wood Dog|kanji=甲戌|romaji=kinoe inu|onyomi=kōjutsu|p=jiǎxū|w=chia-hsü|mi=ʈ͡ʂja̠²¹ ɕy⁵³|y=gaap6 seot1|j=gaap6 seot1|ci=kaːp̚ sœt̚|mc=kæp syt|oc-bs=kaːp ʔsuʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Wood Dog''' (甲戌, ''kinoe inu''; onyomi ''kōjutsu'') is the 11th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 11th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Water Rooster|ja|癸酉}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Wood Pig|ja|乙亥}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''甲'' is Yang Wood, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''戌'' (Dog) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Wood Dog (甲戌)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jiǎxū
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaap3 seot1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kinoe-inu
*** On'yomi: kōjutsu
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gap sul (갑술)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Giáp Tuất

==Months of Yang Wood Dog==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)}}), the month of {{ill|September|en|September|qid=Q123|lt=September}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of 甲戌. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Cold Dew}} until the day before {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter}}) as applicable.
